about_the_game:
Expansion pack #2 is all about investing in science and industry, like the great capitalist that you are. It's centered around one of the most popular mechanics in the Base set: Money!

It features 2 new cards that give Money and 3 cards that cost Money. It also features Planned Obsolescence, the most powerful combo card in the game so far, which used a new mechanic called Shadow Copy.

More Money, more better

Research Expedition not only gives Money, it also draws! And if that wasn't enough, you can give it Double Strike as well, combining 3 fan-favorite mechanics in one sweet package 🤩.

.

Unfettered Capitalism

So, your deck is full of sweet cards, you're practically swimming in money.. now what? The answer is obvious: play more of those same cards and get even more rich! Planned Obsolescence lets you play another card in your hand 3 times, giving you the potential to play 15 Windmills in one turn 😶.
